meta.description: Jappo turns block farms into financeable, monitored credit transactions.

hero.title: Finance block farms, from plot to repayment.
hero.subtitle: Jappo packages your block farm into a financeable dossier, runs a closed tender with lenders, monitors the season and computes settlement at source — without ever holding funds.

value.operatorText: Block mapping, crop plan, budget, financial model, scored dossier and a closed tender to qualified lenders.
value.lenderText: A pipeline of standard dossiers, a data room, live monitoring and a repayment waterfall controlled from the escrow account.
value.farmerText: Inputs on credit, a guaranteed buyer and a clear statement of every deduction, sent by SMS.

how.title: The settlement waterfall
steps: The buyer pays into the lender's escrow account
The net balance is paid to each farmer

footer.rights: Jappo provides technology and structuring services. Credit decisions belong to lenders.
